Alternating_Deltoid_Raise: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise one arm in front to shoulder height and, as you lower it, raise the other out to the side.
Alternate arms and directions with control, without swinging.
Anti-Gravity_Press: Lie face down on an incline bench with a light bar beside your shoulders.
Press the bar forwards and up, in line with your body, until your arms are straight.
Return with control. Use very little weight.
Body_Tricep_Press: Put your hands on a fixed bar at hip height and lean forward with your body straight.
Bend only your elbows to lower your forehead towards the bar.
Straighten your arms by pushing with your triceps.
Bodyweight_Flyes: Get into a push-up position with your hands on two sliders or two wheeled bars.
Slide your hands out to the sides, lowering your chest with your elbows slightly bent.
Bring them together again, squeezing your chest. Start on your knees if it is too hard.
Bosu_Ball_Cable_Crunch_With_Side_Bends: Lie on a Bosu ball holding a low pulley rope beside your head.
Do a crunch and, at the top, bend to one side.
Return to the centre, lower with control and alternate sides.
Cable_Judo_Flip: Standing side-on to a high pulley, hold the rope with both hands above your shoulder.
Pull diagonally down towards the opposite hip while rotating your torso, as if throwing someone over your shoulder.
Return with control and switch sides.
Chain_Handle_Extension: Lie on a bench with a handle in each hand with chains hanging from it.
With your arms up, bend your elbows, lowering the handles beside your head.
Straighten your arms: the load increases as you press up.
Dancers_Stretch: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and let it fall to the opposite side across your body, with your shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Downward_Facing_Balance: Lie face down on an exercise ball with your hands on the floor.
Raise your straight legs until they are in line with your torso, squeezing your glutes.
Hold for a few seconds and lower with control.
Drop_Push: Get into a push-up position with your hands on two low boxes.
Drop your hands to the floor between the boxes and, as you land, push up explosively.
Bring your hands back onto the boxes and repeat.
Dumbbell_Raise: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides with your elbows slightly bent to shoulder height.
Extended_Range_One-Arm_Kettlebell_Floor_: Lie on your back on a low step with a kettlebell in one hand at chest height.
Let your elbow drop below your back to gain range.
Press until your arm is straight. Switch sides.
Flexor_Incline_Dumbbell_Curls: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your wrists curled in.
Curl the dumbbells up by bending your elbows, keeping your wrists curled.
Heavy_Bag_Thrust: Stand in front of a heavy punch bag with your hands at your chest.
Push the bag forcefully by straightening your arms and taking a step.
Catch the bag as it swings back and repeat.
Incline_Push-Up_Depth_Jump: Get into a push-up position with your hands on a low box.
Drop your hands to the floor and push up explosively to bring them back onto the box.
Keep your body straight throughout the movement.
Iron_Cross: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise them in front to shoulder height and open them out to the sides into a cross.
Bring them back to the front and lower them with control.
Leg-Over_Floor_Press: Lie on your back with a kettlebell in one hand and cross the leg on that side over the other.
Press the kettlebell until your arm is straight; the crossed leg makes your core work.
Leg_Lift: Standing, lean on a wall or a chair back.
Take one straight leg back, squeezing your glute, without arching your back.
Return with control and switch legs.
London_Bridges: Hold a thick rope anchored above you and lean back with your body straight and your heels on the floor.
Climb up hand over hand until you are almost standing.
Come back down the same way, with control.
Lower_Back_Curl: Lie face down with your hands on the floor beside your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor by straightening your arms, keeping your hips down.
Hold for a few seconds, feeling the stretch in your abs, and lower.
Lunge_Sprint: Get into a lunge position with your front leg bent.
Explode from there and sprint flat out for a few metres.
Walk back and repeat with the other leg in front.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Para_Press: Hold a kettlebell by your shoulder with your elbow pointing out to the side.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Peroneals_Stretch: Hold your foot and turn it inwards, bringing the sole towards you.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch on the outside of your lower leg.
Posterior_Tibialis_Stretch: Hold your foot and turn it outwards, pulling your toes towards you.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch on the inside of your lower leg.
Power_Stairs: Hold a dumbbell or light weight in front of some stairs or stepped boxes.
Climb each step with an explosive push from the standing leg.
Pyramid: Kneel with your forearms resting on an exercise ball.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips, drawing the ball towards you to form a pyramid.
Hold for a few seconds and return with control.
Quick_Leap: Stand in front of a low box.
Dip slightly and jump quickly onto the box, landing softly.
Step down and repeat as fast as you can.
Rack_Delivery: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs with a clean grip.
Extend your hips and ankles and pull the bar upwards.
Rotate your elbows underneath and catch it on the front of your shoulders.
Return_Push_from_Stance: Get into an athletic stance with a medicine ball by your chest.
Turn and throw the ball forcefully at a wall or a partner.
Shoulder_Raise: Standing or seated, with your arms relaxed.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold for a moment and let them drop, relaxed.
Squat_with_Plate_Movers: Hold a plate with both hands in front of your chest.
Squat down and, at the bottom, push the plate out in front, straightening your arms.
Bring it back to your chest and stand up.
Straight_Bar_Bench_Mid_Rows: Lie face down on a high bench with a bar on the floor under your chest.
Row the bar towards the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
